definitions: To go through a place or area, often without stopping or staying for long.
To experience a particular stage or period, especially a difficult one.
To be officially approved or accepted, especially by a legislative body.
To be transmitted or transferred from one person or thing to another.
examples: We will pass through London on our way to Scotland.
The country is passing through a period of economic uncertainty.
The new law is expected to pass through Parliament easily.
The message passed through several intermediaries before reaching me.
